points.quote: `api/` provides the `vscode.d.ts` API. It contains the extension host implementation and the main-thread counterparts
`services/` holds core services that aren't specific to one feature.
`contrib/` holds feature contributions. It has about 101 folders
Nothing outside `contrib/` may depend on code inside it.
Each contribution has a single `.contribution.ts` file that registers it.
A contribution exposes its internal API from a single `common` file.
Other contributions must depend on that common API, not on another contribution's internals.
